title: Handling of congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane

entities.name: Congestion control for transport of user data via control plane active
entities.description: Network-activated congestion control state for user data transport via control plane as specified in 3GPP TS 23.401.

entities.name: Control plane data back-off timer T3448
entities.description: Timer started by UE with value provided by network in ATTACH ACCEPT, TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT, SERVICE ACCEPT or SERVICE REJECT messages to defer user data transport via control plane.

entities.name: UE support for control plane data back-off timer
entities.description: UE capability indication for supporting control plane data back-off timer functionality.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Network to UE message that may contain T3448 timer value.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Network to UE message that may contain or omit T3448 timer value.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: Network to UE message that may contain or omit T3448 timer value.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: Network to UE message that may contain T3448 timer value.

entities.name: T3448 value IE
entities.description: Information element carrying the control plane data back-off timer value.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management idle state where UE restrictions apply for user data transport via control plane.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management deregistered state that stops T3448 timer.

entities.name: Transport of user data via the control plane
entities.description: Procedure for transporting user data via control plane that is restricted when T3448 is running.

entities.name: Exception data reporting allowed
entities.description: Condition where UE is allowed to send user data via control plane even when T3448 is running, for exceptional events.

relations.description: When congestion control is active, network includes T3448 value in ATTACH ACCEPT message.
ATTACH ACCEPT message contains T3448 value IE when congestion control is active.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message without T3448 value IE stops T3448 timer.
SERVICE ACCEPT message without T3448 value IE stops T3448 timer.
UE in EMM-IDLE mode shall not initiate user data transport via control plane when T3448 is running.
Exception data reporting allowed condition permits user data transport via control plane even when T3448 is running.
Entering EMM-DEREGISTERED state stops T3448 timer.
